decisions.reason: The second V remains derived from the Hero V and continues to share its proportions; the source refines the Hero V geometry without changing that derivation rule or independently specifying the second V.
The accent's requirement to derive from the Hero V geometry remains valid unchanged, and the source does not independently change the accent's geometry or role.
The source discusses the V's silhouette, arms, and proportions and does not change or resume the deferred E and L letterform requirement.
Refining the Hero V's silhouette does not change the established hierarchy in which the closing V remains smaller and subordinate.
The client provides design feedback about the Hero V but does not change the requirement for the freelancer to include design rationale with review rounds.
The source does not address kerning or resume the deferred full-wordmark kerning work.
The source refines geometry only and does not alter or resume the deferred champagne material treatment.
The Hero V design refinement has no semantic effect on the accepted proof-file formats.
